<bbm-response>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_0">"It's nothing. Anyway, let's start inspecting the leftover items from the beginning."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_1">*</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_2">"Are you saying that ${黑子} has been acting a bit strange lately?" walking ahead, ${一色} carried her bag, turned her head back, and asked ${美琴}.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_3">"Hmm, how should I put it?" ${美琴} scratched her cheek as she searched for the right words, "Probably that she's been putting too much energy into her Judgment work? And lately, she's barely been... making advances on me?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_4">"Advances?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_5">"You see, ${黑子} used to always be a bit handsy, right? But lately, she's been unusually well-behaved and tactful—or rather, compared to how she was at the very beginning, she's being way too tactful."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_6">"Oh~" ${一色} paused her steps to analyze, "So that means she's being a bit cold toward ${美琴}?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_7">"Cold? I wouldn't go that far..." ${美琴} instinctively touched the back of her head and said, "Well, actually, it is kind of like that."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_8">"And putting too much energy into work, like she's running away from something." ${一色} nodded, drawing a confident conclusion with a serious expression, "Could this be what they call throwing oneself into a career when things go wrong in love?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_9">"W-What?" ${美琴} blinked in surprise.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_10">"In short—she's been dumped."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_11">"H-How is that possible..." ${美琴}'s tone gradually faded.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_12">"Oh dear." ${一色} patted ${美琴}'s shoulder and said, "It's all my fault; I truly am a sinful woman."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_13">"Geez." ${美琴} grabbed ${一色}'s hand and sighed, "No matter what, ${黑子}$ that girl has definitely been way too high-strung lately. She seems to be racking her brains over that 'Void Burst' case."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_14">"Hmm, sitting by and watching a junior rack her brains isn't the style of a reliable senior."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_15">"That's true." ${美琴} smiled, "Even though that girl constantly talks about ordinary citizens and all, we really can't just let her push herself this hard."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_16">"Ah, it's Ruiko." ${一色} spotted ${佐天泪子} appearing across the street and waved her hand while calling out loudly.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_17">"Ruiko..." ${美琴} cast a subtle glance at ${一色}. When did this girl start using such an affectionate nickname for classmate Saten?</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_18">${美琴} tightened her grip on ${一色}'s little hand, but this girl's hand felt boneless; no matter how much force she exerted, it deformed like flowing water, while the person in question simply looked back at her with a bewildered and oblivious expression.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_19">Watching ${佐天泪子} cheerfully cross the street and approach, ${美琴} let go of ${一色}'s hand.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_20">${佐天泪子} happily greeted ${一色} and ${美琴}, and after exchanging a few pleasantries, the three of them walked together toward a bench in a nearby park.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_21">${美琴} had a lingering feeling that whenever ${佐天泪子} spoke to ${一色}, her eyes kept flashing and sparkling. She wasn't sure if she was just imagining it.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_22">After staring intently for a few dozen seconds, ${美琴} became certain.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_23">Tsk, it really wasn't her imagination.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_24">${一色}, what a sinful woman.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_25">*</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_26">*</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_27">*</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_28">*</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_29">ps. Thanks to Homu-sensei Daima's Salted Fish Thrust</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_30">Thanks to Book-guest 88945837861's Salted Fish Thrust</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_31">Thanks to Amber D's monthly ticket</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_32">Arigato!</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_33">ps2. I somehow feel like I don't know what I want to do.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_34">Chapter 19: ${黑子}'s Troubles</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_35">${白井黑子} has been a bit melancholic lately.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_36">The girl with octopus-style twin tails sat quietly at her desk, her small mirror reflecting a slightly childish face, though it was undeniably of pretty-girl caliber.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_37">${白井黑子} placed the small mirror face down, rested her fair cheek in her hand, and let out a long sigh.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_38">As a young lady of the Shirai family, she had been exceptional in character, learning, and wit since childhood. After coming to ${学园都市}, she continued to stand out among her peers, even becoming one of the youngest members of Judgment—joining Judgment back in her elementary school days and becoming a proud judgelily.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="p5589d69f44d7_39">Moreover, right when she started her frontline internship, she solved a post office robbery case and made a huge contribution.</bbm-unit>
</bbm-response>
